svg.aria-label: The Diffo loop: in the agent's terminal you type /diffo and the review opens; your question on line 14 flies to the agent, which fixes the code and answers; the answer and the fix fly back and land in the thread and the diff

g.text: Today, which is wrong: a bare weekday means the next one.
Fixed, so parseDue('friday') on a Friday rolls a week.
Does “friday” on a Friday mean today or next week?
